title: Spanwit Space Report v2
description: Read-only disk diagnostic report with capacity_accounting planes. capture_mode full preserves v1 inventory shape; capacity_only omits inventory/handoff. Never includes an execute/delete path. No cross-plane explained_bytes total. Application invariants (capacity target and filesystem plane exactly match the primary pressure observation; root remains the requested analysis scope; capacity_only prune hard-fail) are enforced in Go, not fully in JSON Schema.

capture_mode.description: full requires v1 inventory shape; capacity_only forbids inventory/handoff/tuning keys.

pressure.description: Unchanged v1 semantics (statfs primary write/home volume).

analysis_pressure.description: Present when analysis root is on a different volume than pressure.

capacity_accounting.description: Required capacity planes section; self-contained for capacity_only mode.

min_size.description: Opt-in size floor display; "none" when unset.

max_depth.description: Bound on name-shaped unverified and verified discovery depth under root.

sort_mode.description: Ranking policy for verified candidates (advisory only).

reclaim_scope.description: Plan-wide reclaim granularity; carried into exact_plan for replay.

mutation_contract.description: Effective invocation mutation contract (read_only when no-mutation assertion is active).

size_incomplete.description: True when any candidate size is a depth-bounded partial measurement; byte totals are lower bounds only.
True when any full-set unverified entry was depth-bounded; total_bytes is a lower bound even if incomplete rows are top-truncated out of entries.

prune_handoff.description: Optional prune handoff: prunable-only rows from this report (the dry-run for those paths) plus allowlist revalidate commands. Never includes diagnostic-only mass.

recipes.description: Optional guided recipes for diagnostic-only cleanup. Suggested external commands only; never executable by spanwit.

applied_filters.description: Present when opt-in --class/--domain projection was applied. Distinguishes honestly empty filtered views from unfiltered empty inventory.

enabled_domains.description: Resolved domains.enabled policy set (authorize-narrow): which use domains may drive recipes and reclaim. Present only when the config supplied a domains block; absent means the built-in default. This is policy, not the --domain view projection.

applied_filters.description: Canonical inventory projection. Both arrays are always present (possibly empty) when the object is set.

volume_id.description: Opaque filesystem identity for same-volume comparison across platforms.

last_activity_at.description: Newest observed descendant file mtime (RFC3339). Advisory ranking only.

domain.description: Derived from signature taxonomy spine (domain segment).

ecosystem.description: Derived from signature taxonomy spine (ecosystem segment).

catalog_id.description: Optional full-spine id; verified rows normally use signature instead.

recipe_ids.description: Optional stable linkage to guided recipes.

catalog_id.description: Provisional full-spine catalog id for inventory filters.

exact_plan.description: Policy-preserving exact-path plan for prune --from-space-report revalidation.

state.description: Recipes are always diagnostic-only; never prunable.

kind.description: argv (default when omitted) is a single-shot external-command suggestion; structural is a multi-step print-only journey (016A).

steps.description: Ordered steps for kind=structural recipes. Print-only; never auto-executed. Go load rejects argv recipes with steps and structural recipes without steps.

exact_plan.description: Optional closed-set revalidation plan scoped to this recipe (e.g. Cargo-only). Revalidate with prune --from-exact-plan; not the report-wide prune_handoff.

catalog_id.description: Full-spine taxonomy id for domain filtering (e.g. development.rust.rustup).

recipe_step.description: One ordered step in a structural guided recipe. Print-only; spanwit never writes config or deletes.

config_snippet.description: Copy-paste config fragment. Never written by spanwit.

suggested_command.description: Machine-safe argv form plus shell-safe display line. Never auto-executed by spanwit.

byte_claim.description: Numeric claim. Missing numbers are never serialized as zero. bytes is canonical; human is presentation-only.

basis.description: Stable derivation token (not a command string).

detail.description: Curated operator-facing reason; never raw tool stderr.

source.description: Optional override; otherwise inherits enclosing plane source.

held_open_byte_claim.description: Held-open logical byte observation. It is always a lower bound and never a reclaimable or allocated-byte claim.

detail.description: Curated diagnostic text only; never raw lsof/tool stderr.

paths.description: Default empty; must not smuggle path disclosure past held-open policy.

source.description: Stable source token when collection was attempted.

pressure_relation.description: When set, Go must enforce path/mount/volume_id and total/used/available match carrier pressure.

source.description: Stable source token when collection was attempted.
Stable source token when collection was attempted.
Stable source token when collection was attempted.
Stable source token when collection was attempted.

path.description: Only when plane disclosure is full.

held_open_plane.description: Opt-in plane. collection_status not_requested when --held-open was not set. Default disclosure emits no path component.

disclosure.description: Self-describing path disclosure level for shared report files.

privilege.description: Spanwit never self-escalates to close a coverage gap.

temp_plane_coverage.description: OS temp roots this run did not walk, present only under warn/critical primary pressure. Observation only: carries no prune authority and never names children.

size_bytes.description: Exact when measured; lower bound when partial; absent when unavailable.

follow_up.description: Root-level space command for the operator to run explicitly.

completion.description: Whether the requested observation finished without coverage warnings. Mirrors the CLI exit contract (complete=0, partial=1). Never deletion authority.

temp_residue_summary.description: Aggregate of the direct children of the listed temp roots, keyed by fixed product labels. Never names children: a family label is fixed vocabulary, never derived from an entry name, and any entry outside the table is counted under 'other'. Hidden (dot-prefixed) entries are included in every total.

bytes.description: Sum of each entry's own lstat size (a directory record, not its contents). Entry counts are the signal; the temp plane probe owns content sizing.
